scope: V18.2 native Hermes Agent Experience converged with runtime truth, approval semantics, mobile history, lazy MapLibre loading, and release hygiene

verification.nativeHermesBoundary: Official Hermes 0.21.2 citynexus profile, server-side Runs/SSE/stop proxy, and CityNexus MCP V2 remain authoritative
verification.runtimeTruth: DIRECT is displayed until a real native lifecycle/tool event; HERMES_NATIVE_MCP is run data, never a generic timeline constant
verification.approvalBoundary: PLAN_ONLY proposals stop at CityNexus Gateway/Guardian approval; Hermes API approval is not the safety boundary
verification.experience: Real ordered event history, safe raw disclosure, desktop/mobile compact mission sheet, Stop proxy, and reconnect-safe stale state
verification.performance: MapLibre is dynamically imported into a route-only chunk; raw/gzip before-after measurements are in reports/product-v18-3/FRONTEND_PERFORMANCE.md
verification.staging: Release allowlist excludes databases, SQLite WAL/SHM, environments, secrets, caches, virtual environments, old archives, and external Hermes profiles

notes: The official Hermes executable/profile remain outside the repository.
Traveler Capability UX remains a future domain-wired slice, not decorative localStorage authority.
The existing vite-plugin-pwa/v10-sw.js architecture is unchanged; no second handwritten service worker is included.
